papers.title: Salvage abdominoperineal resection for anal squamous cell carcinoma: A systematic review and meta-analysis of proportions
papers.journal_full: Colorectal disease : the official journal of the Association of Coloproctology of Great Britain and Ireland
papers.authors: Belfort G, Pompeu B, Velucci M, Baptista C, Delgado L, Marques F
papers.abstract:
AIM: Salvage abdominoperineal resection (APR) remains the standard treatment for patients with persistent or recurrent anal squamous cell carcinoma after chemoradiotherapy (CRT). This study aimed to evaluate the perioperative and oncological outcomes of salvage abdominoperineal resection.
METHODS: A systematic review of observational studies including adult patients with persistent or recurrent anal squamous cell carcinoma undergoing salvage APR after failure of CRT was conducted using PubMed, Scopus and Cochrane through March 2026. Binary outcomes were pooled as proportions on the logit scale under random-effects models; a generalized linear mixed model was applied when zero-event studies were present. Continuous outcomes as means with 95% confidence intervals (CIs). Heterogeneity was assessed using the I2 statistic. Sensitivity analyses were performed using leave-one-out methods. All analyses were conducted in R version 4.4.2.
RESULTS: Eighteen observational studies comprising 1,013 patients were included. The pooled 2-year and 5-year overall survival (OS) rates were 68.34% (95% CI: 60.42-75.33; I2 = 65%) and 46.43% (95% CI: 38.03-55.04; I2 = 81%), respectively. The pooled 3-year and 5-year disease-free survival rates (DFS) were 50.36% (95% CI: 20.62-79.85; I2 = 95%) and 41.79% (95% CI: 27.80-57.24; I2 = 90%), respectively. The pooled overall recurrence rate was 44.28% (95% CI: 36.63-52.21; I2 = 79%), including locoregional recurrence of 34.03% (95% CI: 27.22-41.57; I2 = 72%) and distant recurrence of 17.39% (95% CI: 12.24-24.13; I2 = 83%). The pooled R0 and R1 resection rates were 79.71% and 17.08%, respectively. Overall morbidity and major complications (Clavien-Dindo ≥III) were 50.70% and 27.97%, respectively. Thirty-day mortality was 1.18% (95% CI: 0.36-3.85; I2 = 0%). Sensitivity analyses showed stable estimates despite heterogeneity.
CONCLUSION: Salvage APR for anal squamous cell carcinoma demonstrated moderate long-term survival, acceptable R0 resection rates and substantial postoperative morbidity. However, the available evidence remains limited by high heterogeneity, non-standardized outcome definitions and the absence of comparative data.

papers.abstract_zh: 目的：對於化放療(CRT)後持續或復發之肛門鱗狀上皮細胞癌病人，挽救性腹會陰聯合切除術(APR)仍為標準治療。本研究旨在評估挽救性APR之圍手術期與腫瘤學結果。方法：透過PubMed、Scopus及Cochrane資料庫，檢索至2026年3月，納入成人持續或復發肛門鱗狀上皮細胞癌於CRT失敗後接受挽救性APR之觀察性研究，進行系統性回顧。二元結果以logit尺度下隨機效應模型匯總為比例；若有零事件研究則採用廣義線性混合模型。連續變項以平均值及95%信賴區間表示。異質性以I²統計量評估。以leave-one-out法進行敏感度分析。所有分析以R 4.4.2版執行。結果：共納入18篇觀察性研究，計1,013名病人。匯總2年及5年整體存活率(OS)分別為68.34%（95% CI: 60.42-75.33；I²=65%）及46.43%（95% CI: 38.03-55.04；I²=81%）。匯總3年及5年無病存活率(DFS)分別為50.36%（95% CI: 20.62-79.85；I²=95%）及41.79%（95% CI: 27.80-57.24；I²=90%）。匯總整體復發率為44.28%（95% CI: 36.63-52.21；I²=79%），其中局部區域復發率為34.03%（95% CI: 27.22-41.57；I²=72%），遠端復發率為17.39%（95% CI: 12.24-24.13；I²=83%）。匯總R0及R1切除率分別為79.71%及17.08%。整體病態率及重大併發症（Clavien-Dindo ≥III）分別為50.70%及27.97%。30天死亡率為1.18%（95% CI: 0.36-3.85；I²=0%）。敏感度分析顯示儘管有異質性，估計值仍屬穩定。結論：肛門鱗狀上皮細胞癌之挽救性APR顯示中等程度長期存活、可接受之R0切除率及顯著的術後病態率。然而現有證據仍受限於高度異質性、非標準化的結果定義，以及缺乏比較性資料。

papers.title: Diet and ileostomy: a qualitative comparison of patient and healthcare professional perspectives in the United Kingdom and Australia
papers.authors: Magee N, Simpson E, McCarthy H, Douglas P, Rosbotham E, Pourshahidi L
papers.abstract:
PURPOSE: Ileostomy formation requires major dietary adjustments to prevent complications and maintain nutritional status, yet dietary advice is often inconsistent, and evidence guiding best practice remains limited. This study explored how people living with an ileostomy (ileostomates) and healthcare professionals (HCPs) experience and support dietary management, uniquely comparing UK and Australian perspectives.
METHOD: Fifty semi-structured interviews were conducted with ileostomates (n = 26) and HCPs (n = 12 stoma care nurses, n = 12 dietitians) across the UK and Australia. Interviews were recorded, transcribed and analysed using thematic content analysis guided by the Social Ecological Model (SEM).
RESULTS: Seven main categories emerged, spanning intrapersonal, interpersonal, community, institutional and public policy factors. Ileostomates reported persistent dietary restriction, fear of food bolus blockages, and reliance on online forums when HCP follow up was limited. HCP transcripts highlighted variations in practice, constrained caseloads, and gaps in evidence underpinning dietary guidance. Country-specific differences were observed, with Australian ileostomates emphasising hydration and geographical barriers. HCPs in the UK highlighted reinforcement of advice from a stoma nurse or dietitian as being central to dietary reintroduction, whereas their Australian counterparts prioritised a patient-led approach.
CONCLUSION: Findings reveal systemic gaps in dietary support across both countries and highlight the need for individualised support, improved professional training, and integration of digital or telehealth solutions to enhance accessibility and continuity of care.
papers.title_zh: 飲食與迴腸造口：英國與澳洲病人及醫療專業人員觀點之質性比較研究
papers.abstract_zh: 目的：迴腸造口手術需要重大飲食調整以預防併發症並維持營養狀態，然而飲食建議常不一致，且指導最佳實務的證據仍有限。本研究探討迴腸造口患者（ileostomates）與醫療專業人員（HCPs）如何經歷與支持飲食管理，並首次比較英國與澳洲的觀點。方法：於英國與澳洲對迴腸造口患者（n=26）與醫療專業人員（造口護理師 n=12、營養師 n=12）共進行50次半結構式訪談。訪談錄音、轉錄後，以社會生態模型（SEM）為指引進行主題內容分析。結果：共浮現七大類別，涵蓋個人內在、人際、社區、機構與公共政策等層面因素。迴腸造口患者報告持續性飲食限制、對食物團阻塞的恐懼，以及在HCP追蹤有限時依賴網路論壇。HCP訪談內容凸顯實務上的差異、案量負荷過重，以及飲食指導證據基礎的不足。觀察到國家間的差異：澳洲迴腸造口患者更強調水分攝取與地理障礙；英國HCP強調造口護理師或營養師持續強化建議對飲食重新引入至關重要，而澳洲同行則優先採取病人主導的方式。結論：研究結果揭示兩國飲食支持存在系統性缺口，凸顯需要個別化支持、改善專業訓練，以及整合數位或遠距醫療解決方案以提升可近性與照護連續性的必要。
papers.score_reason: 質性研究樣本小（僅26位病人）、無量化結果，對臨床決策直接影響有限，但揭示照護落差可供團隊改善造口衛教流程參考。
papers.relevance_why: 雖非外科手術介入研究，但迴腸造口飲食衛教是大腸直腸外科術後照護的核心環節，內容多由造口護理師與營養師執行。

papers.title: Towards standardized gut microbiota diagnostics: normobiosis beyond geographical borders
papers.authors: Hiseni P, Furu K, Wang Pedersen V, Øverland L, Kirubakaran G, Casén C
papers.abstract: Defining clinically meaningful reference states of the human gut microbiota remains a major barrier to the clinical translation of microbiome testing, largely due to variability across populations. We aimed at evaluating whether dysbiosis can be identified in a standardized, geography-independent manner, using a composite, system-level microbiome diagnostic framework. We performed a retrospective observational analysis of 831 adult stool samples collected from healthy individuals and patients with inflammatory bowel disease, irritable bowel syndrome, or other chronic inflammatory conditions across seven countries. In addition, U.S. National Institute of Standards Technology (NIST) human fecal reference materials were analyzed. Dysbiosis was assessed using a fixed microbial marker panel and composite distance metrics anchored to a clinically validated healthy Scandinavian reference population, using GA-map® Dysbiosis Test as an exemplar of this diagnostic framework. The diagnostic framework reproducibly identified normobiosis and dysbiosis across geographically distinct populations (USA, Canada, Germany, Italy, and the UK). Severe dysbiosis was detected with high specificity (93.6%) and positive predictive value (90.2%), independent of subjects' country of origin. Healthy individuals showed highly comparable dysbiosis index distributions across regions. These findings demonstrate that clinically useful dysbiosis diagnostics do not require geographically tailored reference populations and support the feasibility of standardized, geography-independent microbiome diagnostics for clinical application.
papers.title_zh: 邁向標準化腸道菌群診斷：跨越地理疆界的正常菌群狀態
papers.abstract_zh: 定義具臨床意義的人類腸道菌群參考狀態，仍是菌群檢測邁向臨床轉譯的一大障礙，主要原因是不同族群間的變異性。本研究旨在評估是否能以標準化、不受地理限制的方式，透過複合式、系統層級的菌群診斷框架來識別菌群失衡（dysbiosis）。我們對來自七個國家、831份健康個體及發炎性腸道疾病（IBD）、腸躁症（IBS）或其他慢性發炎疾病患者的成人糞便樣本進行回溯性觀察分析。此外，也分析了美國國家標準與技術研究院（NIST）之人類糞便參考物質。菌群失衡的評估採用固定菌群標記面板與複合距離指標，並以經臨床驗證之健康北歐（Scandinavian）參考族群為基準，以GA-map® Dysbiosis Test作為此診斷框架之範例。此診斷框架能在地理上不同的族群（美國、加拿大、德國、義大利、英國）中，可重現地識別正常菌群狀態（normobiosis）與菌群失衡。嚴重菌群失衡的檢測具高特異性（93.6%）與陽性預測值（90.2%），且不受受試者原生國家影響。健康個體在各地區間顯示高度相似的菌群失衡指數分布。這些發現證實，具臨床實用性的菌群失衡診斷並不需要因地理量身訂做的參考族群，並支持標準化、不受地理限制的菌群診斷在臨床應用上的可行性。
papers.score_reason: 此為商業菌群檢測工具的地理可推廣性驗證研究，未涉及大腸直腸手術或癌症相關族群，對台灣大腸直腸外科臨床決策實用性低。
papers.relevance_why: 研究對象為IBD、IBS及慢性發炎疾病患者的菌群失衡診斷驗證，非大腸直腸癌手術介入或相關臨床決策。
papers.one_liner: 在831份來自7國的成人糞便樣本中，驗證以北歐參考群為基準的菌群失衡診斷框架，發現嚴重失衡診斷特異性93.6%、PPV 90.2%，不受地理差異影響。

papers.title: Standardised Pfannenstiel versus supraumbilical muscle-sparing transverse extraction sites in colon cancer surgery: An IDEAL stage 4 report
papers.journal_full: Colorectal disease : the official journal of the Association of Coloproctology of Great Britain and Ireland
papers.authors: Rasmussen M, Baastrup N, Olsen A, Gundestrup A, Kanstrup C, Kleif J
papers.abstract:
AIM: To compare long-term incisional hernia (IH) risk between Pfannenstiel and supraumbilical muscle-sparing transverse extraction sites following minimally invasive colon cancer surgery with standardised fascial closure. Reported according to the IDEAL framework (Stage 4).
METHOD: This single-centre study included patients (Stages I-III colon adenocarcinoma, 2014-2017) undergoing laparoscopic resection via Pfannenstiel or supraumbilical incisions. Fascial closure used continuous slowly absorbable poly-4-hydroxybutyrate sutures (ratio ≥ 4:1). The primary endpoint was CT-verified IH at the extraction site at 5 years. Inverse Probability of Treatment Weighting (IPTW) adjusted for baseline covariates.
RESULTS: The final cohort comprised 245 patients (Pfannenstiel, n = 141; supraumbilical, n = 104). The median follow-up was 5.3 and 5.6 years, respectively. In the unadjusted analysis, the 5-year IH risk was 15.4% (95% CI: 9.5-21.3) for Pfannenstiel and 18.8% (95% CI: 11.2-26.4) for supraumbilical incisions (p = 0.49). Following IPTW adjustment, the estimated risks were 14.6% (95% CI: 8.9-20.3) and 13.6% (95% CI: 7.7-19.4), respectively (adjusted risk difference - 1.0%; 95% CI: -9.2-7.2, p = 0.81). Only two (0.8%) of the 245 patients underwent surgical hernia repair.
CONCLUSION: The IH risk seems not associated with the extractions site incision, Pfannenstiel and supraumbilical muscle-sparing transverse extraction sites, when standardised closure techniques are applied. These findings challenge the assumption that Pfannenstiel sites are inherently superior for hernia prevention. The choice of extraction site based on anastomosis technique may not be justified; instead, it should be guided by oncological requirements and procedural ergonomics rather than perceived differences in hernia risk.
TRIAL REGISTRATION: Danish Patient Safety Authority (#31-1522-51).
papers.title_zh: 大腸癌手術中標準化Pfannenstiel切口與臍上肌肉保留橫切取出部位之比較：IDEAL第四階段報告
papers.abstract_zh:
目的：比較微創大腸癌手術中，採用標準化筋膜縫合技術後，Pfannenstiel切口與臍上肌肉保留橫切取出部位之長期切口疝（IH）風險。依IDEAL框架（第四階段）報告。

方法：本單一中心研究納入2014-2017年間接受腹腔鏡切除術之第I-III期大腸腺癌病人，取出部位為Pfannenstiel或臍上切口。筋膜縫合採用連續、緩慢可吸收之poly-4-hydroxybutyrate縫線（縫線長度與傷口長度比≥4:1）。主要終點為術後5年CT確認之取出部位切口疝。以逆機率治療加權（IPTW）調整基線共變項。

結果：最終世代共245位病人（Pfannenstiel組n=141；臍上組n=104）。中位追蹤時間分別為5.3年與5.6年。未調整分析中，5年切口疝風險Pfannenstiel組為15.4%（95% CI: 9.5-21.3），臍上組為18.8%（95% CI: 11.2-26.4）（p=0.49）。經IPTW調整後，估計風險分別為14.6%（95% CI: 8.9-20.3）與13.6%（95% CI: 7.7-19.4）（調整後風險差異-1.0%；95% CI: -9.2至7.2，p=0.81）。245位病人中僅2位（0.8%）接受手術疝氣修補。

結論：當採用標準化縫合技術時，切口疝風險似乎與取出部位切口類型（Pfannenstiel或臍上肌肉保留橫切）無關。此結果挑戰了Pfannenstiel切口在預防疝氣上天生較優的假設。基於吻合技術選擇取出部位可能沒有充分理由；反之，應以腫瘤學需求與手術人體工學為考量，而非切口疝風險的認知差異。

試驗註冊：丹麥病人安全局（#31-1522-51）。
papers.score_reason: 單一中心、非隨機比較研究，雖以IPTW調整並用CT客觀確認結果，但信賴區間寬、僅0.8%需手術修補，臨床意義有限，仍具實務參考價值。
papers.relevance_why: 取出部位的選擇是每台腹腔鏡大腸癌手術都會面臨的實際決策，直接影響台灣大腸直腸外科日常操作。

papers.title: Comparison of Three Minimally Invasive Surgical Approaches for Restorative Proctocolectomy in Ulcerative Colitis: A Retrospective Study
papers.authors: Okabayashi K, Shigeta K, Matsuda S, Kitagawa Y
papers.abstract:
INTRODUCTION: Restorative proctocolectomy (RPC) is the most frequently performed procedure for patients with ulcerative colitis (UC) requiring surgical intervention. Although several approaches to laparoscopic RPC for UC have been documented, the optimal minimally invasive surgical (MIS) approach remains to be firmly established. This study aims to compare the postoperative complication rates and surgical outcomes of three MIS approaches for RPC: laparoscopic surgery (Lap), hand-assisted laparoscopic surgery (HALS), and reduced port surgery combined with taTME (RPS + taTME).
METHODS: This retrospective study included 156 patients who underwent two-stage RPC for UC via laparoscopy at Keio University Hospital between February 2002 and February 2022. The influence of patient characteristics on postoperative complications and surgical outcomes was evaluated using Fisher's exact test, analysis of variance (ANOVA), or logistic regression analysis.
RESULTS: Of the 156 patients, 60 underwent Lap, 46 underwent HALS, and 50 underwent RPS + taTME. Postoperative complication rates were 43.3% for Lap, 50.0% for HALS, and 36.0% for RPS + taTME. There were no significant differences in postoperative complications between the surgical approaches (HALS vs. Lap: odds ratio (OR) 0.54, 95% confidence interval (CI) 0.18-1.69, p = 0.29; RPS + taTME versus Lap: OR 1.57, 95% CI 0.63-3.89, p = 0.33). Operative time was significantly shorter in the HALS group, while estimated blood loss was significantly lower in the RPS + taTME group.
CONCLUSION: This study highlights the distinct characteristics of three MIS approaches for laparoscopic RPC. The incidence of postoperative complications did not differ significantly among the techniques. These findings provide valuable insights for colorectal surgeons, facilitating the selection of optimal surgical techniques for the management of UC.

papers.title_zh: 潰瘍性大腸炎病人接受迴腸儲存袋肛管吻合手術（RPC）之三種微創手術方式比較：回溯性研究
papers.abstract_zh:
背景：迴腸儲存袋肛管吻合手術（RPC）是需手術治療之潰瘍性大腸炎（UC）病人最常施行的術式。雖已有多種腹腔鏡RPC術式被報告，但何者為最佳微創（MIS）方式仍未確立。本研究旨在比較三種MIS術式—傳統腹腔鏡（Lap）、手輔助腹腔鏡（HALS）、以及縮孔手術合併經肛全直腸系膜切除術（RPS+taTME）—在RPC手術中之術後併發症發生率與手術結果。

方法：本回溯性研究納入2002年2月至2022年2月間於慶應大學醫院接受兩階段腹腔鏡RPC治療之UC病人共156例。以Fisher精確檢定、變異數分析（ANOVA）或邏輯迴歸分析評估病人特徵對術後併發症及手術結果之影響。

結果：156例中，60例接受Lap、46例接受HALS、50例接受RPS+taTME。術後併發症發生率分別為Lap 43.3%、HALS 50.0%、RPS+taTME 36.0%。三種手術方式間術後併發症無顯著差異（HALS vs. Lap：勝算比[OR] 0.54，95%信賴區間[CI] 0.18–1.69，p=0.29；RPS+taTME vs. Lap：OR 1.57，95% CI 0.63–3.89，p=0.33）。HALS組手術時間顯著較短，RPS+taTME組出血量顯著較少。

結論：本研究呈現三種MIS RPC術式之各自特點。三種術式間術後併發症發生率無顯著差異。這些發現為大腸直腸外科醫師在UC治療選擇最佳手術技術時提供有價值的參考。

papers.title: Evaluation of serum human galectin 3 as a marker of activity in inflammatory bowel disease in comparison to fecal calprotectin
papers.authors: Salama M, Sayed M, Saad M, Ali N, Abdelwahed M, Elessawy H
papers.abstract: Inflammatory Bowel Disease (IBD) is a chronic and recurring inflammatory condition of the gastrointestinal system that has an unknown cause and is marked by periods of relapse and remission. Endoscopy remains the gold standard for assessing disease activity; however, noninvasive biomarkers are needed to reduce the burden of repeated invasive procedures. This study aimed to evaluate the role of serum galectin 3 as a biomarker of disease activity in IBD and compare its performance with fecal calprotectin. The study included 40 individuals who were diagnosed with active IBD ulcerative colitis (UC) or Crohn's disease, and 40 age and sex matched normal controls. Clinical assessment and laboratory investigations which included complete blood picture, C-reactive protein, fecal calprotectin, serum albumin and serum galectin 3 were measured and analyzed. Serum galectin 3 levels were higher in patients with active UC than in clinical remission patients (p<0.001) and higher in patients with Crohn's disease (p<0.001). In clinical, remission patients without full mucosal healing, serum galectin 3 was positively correlated with endoscopic disease activity represented with Mayo score, Mayo endoscopic sub-score and Ulcerative Colitis Endoscopic Index of Severity (p<0.001). The cut off value of serum galectin 3 for determining disease activity was >5.199 µg/ml with 100 % sensitivity, 92 %, specificity and accuracy of 99.6%.The combined use of Serum galectin 3, CRP and fecal calprotectin improved the performance, achieving 100% sensitivity and specificity. In conclusion, serum galectin 3 is a promising noninvasive biomarker for assessing disease activity in patients with IBD. Combined assessment with CRP and fecal calprotectin may further enhance the diagnostic accuracy.

papers.title_zh: 評估血清人類半乳糖凝集素3作為發炎性腸道疾病活性指標並與糞便鈣衛蛋白比較
papers.abstract_zh: 發炎性腸道疾病（IBD）是一種病因不明、以緩解與復發交替為特徵的慢性、反覆性胃腸道發炎疾病。內視鏡檢查仍是評估疾病活性的黃金標準；然而，需要非侵入性生物標記以減少重複侵入性檢查的負擔。本研究旨在評估血清半乳糖凝集素3（galectin 3）作為IBD疾病活性生物標記的角色，並與糞便鈣衛蛋白（fecal calprotectin）比較其表現。研究納入40名診斷為活動期IBD（潰瘍性結腸炎UC或克隆氏症）的個案，以及40名年齡與性別匹配的正常對照組。進行臨床評估與實驗室檢查，包括全血球計數、C反應蛋白、糞便鈣衛蛋白、血清白蛋白與血清半乳糖凝集素3並加以分析。活動期UC病人的血清半乳糖凝集素3高於臨床緩解病人（p<0.001），克隆氏症病人亦然（p<0.001）。在未達完全黏膜癒合的臨床緩解病人中，血清半乳糖凝集素3與內視鏡疾病活性（以Mayo score、Mayo內視鏡子分數、潰瘍性結腸炎內視鏡嚴重度指數表示）呈正相關（p<0.001）。血清半乳糖凝集素3用於判斷疾病活性的切點值為>5.199 µg/ml，敏感度100%、特異度92%、準確度99.6%。合併使用血清半乳糖凝集素3、CRP與糞便鈣衛蛋白可提升表現，達到100%敏感度與特異度。結論：血清半乳糖凝集素3是評估IBD病人疾病活性的一個有前景的非侵入性生物標記。合併CRP與糞便鈣衛蛋白評估可能進一步提升診斷準確度。

papers.title: Colorectal Cancer Treatment Delay Thresholds and Metastasis Risk
papers.authors: Nguyen C, Skaar T, Imperiale T, Johnson T, Monahan P, Turk A
papers.abstract:
IMPORTANCE: Timely treatment in colorectal cancer (CRC) may influence the disease course and, thus, outcomes, but optimal delay thresholds remain uncertain. Identifying pathway-specific time-to-treatment initiation (TTI) effects can guide benchmarks and policies for coordinated, timely care.
OBJECTIVE: To evaluate the association between TTI and 3-year metastasis risk in patients with newly diagnosed nonmetastatic CRC undergoing curative-intent surgery, with attention to variation by treatment pathway.
DESIGN, SETTING, AND PARTICIPANTS: This cohort study of insured US patients with nonmetastatic CRC used deidentified administrative claims from Optum's Clinformatics Data Mart. Eligible individuals were adults aged 40 years or older with incident nonmetastatic CRC diagnosed during January 1, 2017, to December 31, 2021, who underwent curative-intent surgery within 1 year of diagnosis and had continuous coverage 1 year before and after. Data were analyzed June 2025.
EXPOSURES: TTI was defined as days from CRC diagnosis to the first receipt of cancer-directed therapy (surgery, chemotherapy, or radiation). Patients were categorized into 4 treatment pathways: surgery with or without radiation, surgery followed by adjuvant therapy with or without radiation, neoadjuvant therapy followed by surgery with or without radiation, and trimodality therapy (neoadjuvant therapy, followed by surgery, followed by adjuvant therapy with or without radiation).
MAIN OUTCOMES AND MEASURES: The outcome was 3-year cumulative incidence of metastasis. XGBoost identified optimal TTI thresholds, and Fine-Gray models with death as a competing risk evaluated these thresholds and estimated their associations with metastasis.
RESULTS: Among 11 927 patients (mean [SD] age, 70.7 [10.8] years; 6007 women [50.4%]; 1251 Black [10.5%], 7948 White [66.6%]), 4539 (38.0%) had moderate or severe comorbidity. Over 3 years, 1438 patients (12.1%) developed metastasis. Longer TTIs were associated with higher metastasis risk, varying by treatment pathway. For surgery plus adjuvant therapy, TTIs of 4 to 46 days (subdistribution hazard ratio [sHR], 1.27; 95% CI, 1.04-1.55) and 47 days or longer (sHR, 1.55; 95% CI, 1.08-2.23) were significantly associated with increased risk vs zero to 3 days. For surgery followed by radiation, delays of 223 days or longer showed higher risk (sHR, 2.00; 95% CI, 0.95-4.25) than TTI up to 222 days, although these results were not significant. For neoadjuvant therapy plus surgery, TTI of 68 days or longer were associated with higher risk (sHR, 2.66; 95% CI, 1.02-6.94) than TTI up to 67 days. For patients receiving trimodality therapy, there was no association between TTI and risk of metastasis.
CONCLUSIONS AND RELEVANCE: In this cohort study, treatment delays were associated with higher, pathway-specific metastasis risk. These findings support pathway-tailored benchmarks for treatment initiation and highlight the importance of integrated care in reducing delays and improving timely, equitable, cost-effective CRC care.
papers.title_zh: 大腸直腸癌治療延遲閾值與轉移風險
papers.abstract_zh: 重要性：大腸直腸癌（CRC）的及時治療可能影響疾病病程及預後，但最適當的延遲閾值仍不明確。找出治療路徑特異性的治療起始時間（TTI）效應，可作為協調性、及時照護之基準與政策依據。目的：評估在接受根治性手術之新診斷非轉移性CRC患者中，TTI與3年轉移風險之關聯，並關注不同治療路徑間的差異。設計、場域與參與者：本世代研究使用Optum's Clinformatics Data Mart之去識別化行政理賠資料，納入2017年1月1日至2021年12月31日期間新診斷非轉移性CRC、於診斷後1年內接受根治性手術、且診斷前後各1年皆有連續保險涵蓋之40歲以上成人。資料於2025年6月進行分析。暴露：TTI定義為自CRC診斷至首次接受癌症導向治療（手術、化療或放射治療）之天數。患者分為4種治療路徑：單純手術（合併或不合併放療）、手術後輔助治療（合併或不合併放療）、新輔助治療後手術（合併或不合併放療）、及三模式治療（新輔助治療、手術、輔助治療，合併或不合併放療）。主要結果與測量：結果為3年轉移累積發生率。使用XGBoost找出最適TTI閾值，並以Fine-Gray模型（將死亡視為競爭風險）評估這些閾值並估計其與轉移之關聯。結果：在11,927名患者中（平均[SD]年齡70.7[10.8]歲；女性6007人[50.4%]；黑人1251人[10.5%]，白人7948人[66.6%]），4539人（38.0%）有中重度共病。3年間，1438名患者（12.1%）發生轉移。較長的TTI與較高的轉移風險相關，且依治療路徑而異。對於手術加輔助治療者，TTI 4至46天（子分布風險比[sHR]，1.27；95% CI，1.04-1.55）及47天以上（sHR，1.55；95% CI，1.08-2.23）相較於0至3天顯著增加風險。對於手術後放療者，延遲223天以上顯示較高風險（sHR，2.00；95% CI，0.95-4.25），但相較於TTI 222天以內未達統計顯著。對於新輔助治療加手術者，TTI 68天以上相較於67天以內風險較高（sHR，2.66；95% CI，1.02-6.94）。對於接受三模式治療者，TTI與轉移風險無關聯。結論與相關性：本世代研究顯示，治療延遲與較高的、路徑特異性的轉移風險相關。此發現支持依治療路徑量身訂做治療起始時間之基準，並凸顯整合照護在減少延遲、改善及時、公平且具成本效益之CRC照護上的重要性。

papers.title: Taxonomy, carcinogenic mechanisms, and advanced molecular diagnosis of Fusobacterium nucleatum in colorectal cancer: from bench to clinical practice
papers.authors: Li B, Dong Y, Dai Y, Zhang M, Zou Z, Yang H
papers.abstract: Fusobacterium nucleatum (Fn) is recognized as a novel oncogenic organism closely correlated with colorectal cancer (CRC). Fn can induce gut dysbiosis and promote tumorigenesis through various mechanisms, including activation of oncogenic signaling, modulation of the immune microenvironment, metabolic reprogramming, and epigenetic regulation. Although recent technological breakthroughs have yielded high-resolution Fn detection indicators, clinical translation remains compromised by subspecies heterogeneity, emerging taxonomic updates, and non-standardization of diagnostic platforms. This review integrates recent developments regarding Fn pathogenic mechanisms and taxonomic identification in CRC, including genetic heterogeneity analysis at the species and subspecies levels, elucidation of multi-dimensional oncogenic molecular mechanisms, and application of high-resolution detection technologies. Special focus is placed on advancing these findings toward early noninvasive diagnostic markers. Additionally, we discuss the limitations of current studies, technical bottlenecks, and potential directions for future research to pave the way for standardized clinical screening.C.

papers.title: Traditional Chinese medicine as a potential barrier-oriented sensitization strategy for immune checkpoint blockade in microsatellite-stable colorectal cancer: from resistance mechanisms to translational validation
papers.authors: Wang D, Wang Y, Wang X
papers.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Microsatellite-stable colorectal cancer (MSS-CRC) is refractory to immune checkpoint inhibitors (ICIs), mainly because of low tumor immunogenicity, impaired antigen presentation, immune exclusion, and myeloid- or Treg-dominated immunosuppression. Traditional Chinese medicine (TCM), characterized by multi-component and multi-target regulation, may provide complementary approaches for modulating these resistance barriers. This review summarizes the rationale, evidence, and translational requirements for integrating TCM with ICI-based therapy in MSS-CRC.
PURPOSE: To evaluate the potential of TCM to regulate immune-resistance mechanisms in MSS-CRC and to propose a barrier-oriented framework for rational TCM-ICI combination strategies.
METHODS: A structured narrative review was conducted in PubMed, Web of Science, Embase, Scopus, CNKI, and Wanfang for studies published from January 2019 to March 2026. Searches covered MSS/pMMR CRC, immune checkpoint blockade, TCM interventions, tumor microenvironment, microbiota, immunometabolism, syndrome patterns, active constituents, and herbal quality control. Eligible studies addressed MSS/pMMR CRC immunotherapy, TCM or phytomedicine-based interventions, or immune-resistance mechanisms. Direct MSS/pMMR CRC studies involving ICI combinations were prioritized, while broader CRC, cross-cancer, pharmacological, and computational studies were used as supportive evidence.
RESULTS: Selected TCM interventions may improve ICI responsiveness in MSS-CRC when matched to specific resistance barriers. Representative interventions include Zhenqi Fuzheng Granules, Shenqi Yichang Formula, Gegen Qinlian Decoction, modified Shenling Baizhu San, Changweiqing, and electroacupuncture-related evidence. These interventions have been linked to immunometabolic remodeling, dendritic-cell mitophagy and antigen presentation, microbiota-driven TME remodeling, Tfh-B-cell interactions, and STING-dependent immune activation. However, direct formula-specific clinical evidence for ICI sensitization in molecularly defined MSS-CRC remains limited. Clinical-translational evidence includes an early phase II study of electroacupuncture combined with fruquintinib and sintilimab in refractory MSS-mCRC, whereas most herbal-formula evidence remains preclinical or indirect. We therefore propose matching TCM interventions and active ingredients to dominant immune-resistance phenotypes and integrating syndrome-informed host-state stratification. These hypotheses require validation using causal assays, organoid-immune co-culture, single-cell/spatial omics, pharmacological standardization, and biomarker-enriched clinical trials.
CONCLUSION: TCM may serve as a complementary, mechanism-informed candidate sensitization strategy for MSS-CRC immunotherapy, but it is not an established standard combination approach. Future translation requires formula-specific and component-level validation, reproducible immune and microbiota-metabolic biomarkers, TCM syndrome assessment, herbal quality control, safety monitoring, and clinically meaningful outcomes.

papers.abstract_zh:
背景：微衛星穩定型大腸直腸癌（MSS-CRC）對免疫檢查點抑制劑（ICI）反應不佳，主要因腫瘤免疫原性低、抗原呈現受損、免疫排除，以及骨髓細胞或調節性T細胞（Treg）主導之免疫抑制所致。傳統中醫藥（TCM）具多成分、多標靶調控特性，可能為調節這些抗性障礙提供輔助途徑。本綜述整理將TCM與ICI基礎治療整合於MSS-CRC之理論基礎、證據與轉譯需求。

目的：評估TCM調節MSS-CRC免疫抗性機轉之潛力，並提出屏障導向架構以合理設計TCM-ICI合併策略。

方法：於PubMed、Web of Science、Embase、Scopus、CNKI及萬方資料庫進行結構化敘述性文獻回顧，涵蓋2019年1月至2026年3月發表之研究。檢索範圍包括MSS/pMMR CRC、免疫檢查點阻斷、TCM介入、腫瘤微環境、微生物群、免疫代謝、證型、活性成分及中藥品質管控。納入研究需探討MSS/pMMR CRC免疫治療、TCM或植物藥介入，或免疫抗性機轉。優先納入涉及MSS/pMMR CRC與ICI合併治療之直接研究，較廣泛之CRC、跨癌種、藥理學及計算研究則作為輔助證據。

結果：特定TCM介入若能對應到特定抗性障礙，可能改善MSS-CRC對ICI之反應性。代表性介入包括真氣扶正顆粒、參芪益腸方、葛根芩連湯、改良參苓白朮散、腸胃清，以及電針相關證據。這些介入與免疫代謝重塑、樹突細胞粒線體自噬與抗原呈現、微生物群驅動之腫瘤微環境重塑、濾泡輔助T細胞（Tfh）-B細胞交互作用，以及STING依賴性免疫活化有關。然而，針對分子確診MSS-CRC之ICI增敏，具方劑特異性之直接臨床證據仍有限。轉譯臨床證據包括一項電針合併呋喹替尼與信迪利單抗治療難治性MSS轉移性CRC之早期第二期研究，而多數中藥方劑證據仍屬臨床前或間接證據。我們因此提出將TCM介入與活性成分對應至主導性免疫抗性表型，並結合證型導向之宿主狀態分層。這些假說需透過因果分析、類器官-免疫共培養、單細胞/空間體學、藥理標準化，以及生物標記富集之臨床試驗加以驗證。

結論：TCM可能作為MSS-CRC免疫治療之輔助、機轉導向候選增敏策略，但尚非已建立之標準合併療法。未來轉譯需進行方劑特異性與成分層級之驗證、可重現之免疫與微生物代謝生物標記、TCM證型評估、中藥品質管控、安全性監測，以及具臨床意義之結果評估。

papers.title: NAFLD-associated immune remodeling in colorectal cancer liver metastasis: mechanisms and implications for immunotherapy
papers.abstract: Non-alcoholic fatty liver disease (NAFLD) affects over 30% of the global adult population and has been increasingly recognized as an adverse prognostic factor for colorectal cancer (CRC) liver metastasis (CRLM). However, the underlying immune mechanisms remain incompletely understood. This review provides a comprehensive synthesis of how NAFLD-induced lipotoxicity reshapes the hepatic immune microenvironment to create a "fertile soil" for CRC metastatic colonization. We delineate a hierarchical immunosuppressive network involving: (1) lipotoxic apoptosis of CD4+ T cells, depleting the helper T cell pool; (2) expansion and functional reinforcement of regulatory T cells (Tregs) through multiple mechanisms (IL-10/TGF-β/IL-35, CD25-mediated IL-2 competition, CTLA-4 engagement, and granzyme B/perforin production); (3) M2 polarization of tumor-associated macrophages; and (4) recruitment of myeloid-derived suppressor cells (MDSCs) via the CXCL5/CXCR2 axis, which suppress CD8+ T cell function. These processes collectively promote CD8+ T cell exhaustion (marked by PD-1, LAG-3, TIM-3 upregulation) and spatial mismatch with metastatic foci. Importantly, we discuss the emerging evidence linking NAFLD-driven immune dysregulation to reduced responsiveness to immune checkpoint inhibitors, while acknowledging the current limitations in direct clinical validation. By integrating mechanistic insights with therapeutic perspectives, this review offers new targets for risk stratification and combination immunotherapy in the growing NAFLD population. papers.abstract_zh: 非酒精性脂肪肝(NAFLD)影響全球超過30%成年人口，且已逐漸被認為是大腸直腸癌(CRC)肝轉移(CRLM)的不良預後因子。然而其潛在免疫機制仍未完全闡明。本綜述全面整合了NAFLD誘發的脂毒性如何重塑肝臟免疫微環境，為CRC轉移性移生創造「肥沃土壤」。我們描繪出一個階層式免疫抑制網絡，包括：(1) CD4+ T細胞的脂毒性凋亡，導致輔助型T細胞池耗竭；(2) 調節性T細胞(Tregs)透過多重機制(IL-10/TGF-β/IL-35、CD25介導的IL-2競爭、CTLA-4結合、以及granzyme B/perforin產生)擴增並強化其功能；(3) 腫瘤相關巨噬細胞的M2極化；以及(4) 透過CXCL5/CXCR2軸招募骨髓來源抑制細胞(MDSCs)，進而抑制CD8+ T細胞功能。這些過程共同促進CD8+ T細胞耗竭(以PD-1、LAG-3、TIM-3上調為標誌)，並與轉移病灶產生空間錯位。重要的是，我們討論了新興證據顯示NAFLD驅動的免疫失調與免疫檢查點抑制劑反應性降低相關，同時承認目前直接臨床驗證的局限性。透過整合機制洞見與治療展望，本綜述為日益增加的NAFLD族群提供風險分層與合併免疫治療的新標的。非酒精性脂肪肝。

papers.title: P38γ Promotes Tumorigenesis Through Activating Immune Evasion
papers.authors: Chandrashekar N, Qi X, Chen G
papers.abstract: Stress MAPKp38γ (MAPK12) has established roles in promoting tumorigenesis; however, the mechanisms involved remain largely unclear. This paper will review recently published and unpublished studies of p38γ in programming immune evasion in breast cancer, pancreatic cancer, and colon cancer to promote tumorigenesis. First, we show that p38γ is an oncogene that transforms breast epithelial cells into triple-negative breast cancer (TNBC), is required for breast tumorigenesis in mice, and activates tumor-suppressive environments via a positive feedback signaling loop. Moreover, we show that epithelial p38γ is required for KRAS-oncogene-induced pancreatic cancer in two genetic murine models (KPC and KTC) by activating glycolytic pathways to provide metabolic support for cancer cells and by increasing chemokine CXCL5-dependent fibrosis and immune cell infiltrations. Lastly, we will delineate how p38γ is activated by the main risk factors for colon cancer and serves as a key integrator of oncogenic and inflammatory signaling to promote tumorigenesis by increasing Wnt proliferative signaling and programming immune evasion. These results indicate that p38γ MAPK can integrate common risk factors for colon cancer and amplify oncogenic signaling by phosphorylating its substrate, β-catenin, increasing transcription of Wnt and the chemokine CXCL13, and promoting PD-L1 expression. In each of these tumor models, we will present evidence supporting our hypothesis, followed by additional experiments for verification. Our studies suggest that targeting p38γ may be an innovative approach in cancer therapeutic intervention.
papers.title_zh: P38γ 透過活化免疫逃逸促進腫瘤生成
papers.abstract_zh: 壓力活化型 MAPK p38γ（MAPK12）已被證實在促進腫瘤生成中扮演角色；然而其涉及的機制大多仍不清楚。本文將回顧近期發表及未發表的研究，探討 p38γ 在乳癌、胰臟癌及大腸癌中如何調控免疫逃逸以促進腫瘤生成。首先，我們顯示 p38γ 是一種致癌基因，能將乳腺上皮細胞轉化為三陰性乳癌（TNBC），在小鼠中為乳房腫瘤生成所必需，並透過正回饋訊號迴路活化腫瘤抑制性微環境。此外，我們顯示上皮性 p38γ 在兩種基因工程小鼠模型（KPC 及 KTC）中，為 KRAS 致癌基因誘發的胰臟癌所必需，其機制為活化糖解路徑以提供癌細胞代謝支持，並透過增加趨化因子 CXCL5 依賴性的纖維化與免疫細胞浸潤。最後，我們將闡述 p38γ 如何被大腸癌主要風險因子活化，並作為整合致癌與發炎訊號的關鍵角色，透過增加 Wnt 增生訊號及調控免疫逃逸來促進腫瘤生成。這些結果顯示，p38γ MAPK 能整合大腸癌常見風險因子，並透過磷酸化其下游底物 β-catenin，增加 Wnt 及趨化因子 CXCL13 的轉錄，以及促進 PD-L1 表現，來放大致癌訊號。在每個腫瘤模型中，我們將呈現支持我們假說的證據，並接續提出額外驗證實驗。我們的研究顯示，針對 p38γ 進行標靶治療，可能是癌症治療介入的一項創新方法。

papers.title: Regenerative Inflammation in IBD: How Type I Interferons and TNF Cross-Talk Converts Epithelial Repair into Therapeutic Response
papers.authors: Hinton E, Kemp R, Schultz M, Gadeock S
papers.abstract: Inflammatory bowel diseases (IBD) are increasingly recognized as disorders in which epithelial dysfunction and maladaptive regeneration may be as important as immune dysregulation. Tumor necrosis factor (TNF), a key mediator of intestinal inflammation and a therapeutic target, plays a dual role in both immune activation and epithelial repair by regulating progenitor cell expansion, lineage plasticity, and chemokine signaling in the intestinal epithelium. During acute injury, TNF-associated responses are generally considered adaptive, supporting crypt repair, barrier restitution, and secretory remodeling pathways. However, in chronic disease, persistent TNF exposure, potentially reinforced by type I interferons (IFN-I), may contribute to the persistence of epithelial regenerative pathways. IFN-I signaling has been suggested in experimental and translational studies to reinforce chemokine networks and transcriptional imprinting. We propose that this potentially converts physiological repair into a sustained state of what we have termed "regenerative inflammation," in which epithelial-derived signals may perpetuate immune recruitment and tissue remodeling. Such TNF-IFN-imprinted epithelial states may contribute to sustained pathology in a subset of patients and could be associated with reduced responsiveness to anti-TNF therapy, although direct causal evidence in human disease remains limited. By integrating mechanistic, organoid-based, and clinical observational evidence, we propose that chronic TNF-IFN crosstalk may contribute to a self-sustaining regenerative inflammatory circuit, providing a conceptual framework for disease persistence in IBD and highlighting potential opportunities to target epithelial-immune interactions.

papers.title_zh: IBD中的再生性發炎：第一型干擾素與TNF交互作用如何將上皮修復轉變為治療反應
papers.abstract_zh: 發炎性腸道疾病（IBD）越來越被認為是一種上皮功能障礙與適應不良再生可能與免疫失調同等重要的疾病。腫瘤壞死因子（TNF）是腸道發炎的關鍵介質及治療標靶，透過調控前驅細胞擴增、譜系可塑性及腸上皮趨化因子訊號，在免疫活化與上皮修復中扮演雙重角色。在急性損傷期間，TNF相關反應通常被視為適應性反應，支持隱窩修復、屏障復原及分泌重塑路徑。然而，在慢性疾病中，持續的TNF暴露，可能因第一型干擾素（IFN-I）而加強，可能導致上皮再生路徑持續存在。實驗與轉譯研究提示IFN-I訊號可能強化趨化因子網絡與轉錄印記。我們提出，這可能將生理性修復轉變為一種我們稱之為「再生性發炎」的持續狀態，其中上皮衍生訊號可能使免疫招募與組織重塑持續進行。此類TNF-IFN印記的上皮狀態可能導致部分病患的持續病理狀態，並可能與抗TNF治療反應性降低有關，儘管在人類疾病中的直接因果證據仍有限。透過整合機轉、類器官研究及臨床觀察性證據，我們提出慢性TNF-IFN交互作用可能促成一個自我維持的再生發炎循環，為IBD疾病持續性提供概念性框架，並凸顯標靶上皮-免疫交互作用的潛在機會。

papers.title: Inducing factors and complication risks of pelvic inflammatory disease: a review
papers.abstract: Pelvic inflammatory disease (PID) is a common infectious condition of the female upper genital tract that imposes a substantial global burden on women's reproductive health and overall quality of life. This narrative review aims to comprehensively synthesize current evidence on the inducing factors and complication risks of PID. We conducted a systematic literature search in PubMed, Embase, and Web of Science databases from January 2010 to December 2025, prioritizing high-quality evidence including systematic reviews, meta-analyses, large-scale population-based cohort studies, and national registry data. The review systematically categorizes PID etiologies into sexually transmitted infections, cervicovaginal dysbiosis, iatrogenic procedures (intrauterine device insertion, assisted reproductive technology, and intrauterine manipulations), anatomical abnormalities, underlying gynecological conditions, lifestyle habits, and environmental exposures, with a particular focus on the emerging role of cervicovaginal microbiota in idiopathic PID. Beyond well-established reproductive sequelae such as tubal infertility, ectopic pregnancy, and chronic pelvic pain, we also summarize evidence linking PID to a broad spectrum of under-recognized systemic complications, including ovarian and colorectal cancer, cardiovascular and metabolic disorders, intestinal obstruction, and mental health problems. The findings underscore the critical importance of early diagnosis, appropriate antimicrobial treatment, and comprehensive risk stratification for optimizing clinical outcomes and reducing the long-term burden of PID.

papers.title: Selective COX-2 inhibitors for short-term musculoskeletal pain in inflammatory bowel disease in remission: a narrative review
papers.abstract: Selective cyclooxygenase-2 (COX-2) inhibitors are often considered when anti-inflammatory analgesia is needed for musculoskeletal pain in patients with inflammatory bowel disease (IBD), but concerns remain about intestinal safety. The clinical evidence on short-term selective COX-2 inhibitor use in IBD, with focus on disease activity outcomes, was reviewed. A prespecified literature search was performed in PubMed and the Cochrane Library supplemented by reference list screening. Clinical trials and clinical studies evaluating celecoxib, etoricoxib or rofecoxib in patients with IBD and musculoskeletal/rheumatological symptoms were considered when gastrointestinal (GI) outcomes were reported. Two placebo-controlled randomised trials did not show higher rates of IBD relapse or symptom aggravation vs placebo during short-term treatment in selected patients, including ulcerative colitis in remission and IBD with rheumatic manifestations. Open-label studies and retrospective series reported variable GI adverse events and occasional symptom worsening, but study populations, baseline disease activity, relapse definitions and follow-up duration differed widely. Overall, the strongest available evidence supports cautious short-term use of selective COX-2 inhibitors in selected patients with IBD in remission when anti-inflammatory analgesia is required. Given the small evidence base and limited follow-up, treatment should be time-limited, use the lowest effective dose and include clinical monitoring.
papers.title_zh: 選擇性COX-2抑制劑用於緩解期發炎性腸道疾病（IBD）患者短期肌肉骨骼疼痛之敘述性回顧

papers.title: Autoimmune diseases in the era of COVID-19: emerging mechanisms, clinical implications, vaccine considerations, and future directions
papers.journal_full: The Korean journal of internal medicine
papers.authors: Kong J, Hong S, Oh J, Lee S, Smith L, Branda F
papers.abstract: The coronavirus disease 2019 (COVID-19) pandemic has highlighted a complex, bidirectional relationship between SARSCoV-2 infection and autoimmune diseases. This review examines how SARS-CoV-2 infection influences the incidence, progression, and outcomes of five major autoimmune conditions: systemic lupus erythematosus, rheumatoid arthritis, multiple sclerosis, inflammatory bowel disease, and Guillain-Barré syndrome. Patients with autoimmune diseases are at increased risk of severe COVID-19 due to intrinsic immune dysregulation and the use of immunosuppressive therapies, both of which impair antiviral host defenses. Conversely, COVID-19 has been implicated in the initiation and exacerbation of autoimmune responses through mechanisms such as molecular mimicry and bystander activation. Concerns have also arisen regarding the safety and efficacy of COVID-19 vaccines in immunocompromised populations. Although vaccines are generally tolerated in these individuals, certain immunosuppressive therapies may attenuate humoral and cellular immune responses. Strategies such as adjusting immunosuppressive regimens and optimizing the timing of vaccination have been proposed to improve vaccine efficacy. Disease-specific considerations are essential to balance infection risk with adequate control of autoimmune activity. Overall, this review underscores the importance of individualized treatment strategies, close clinical monitoring, and interdisciplinary care in managing patients with autoimmune diseases during the COVID-19 pandemic. A deeper understanding of these interactions will be critical for improving patient outcomes and preparing for future pandemics involving immune-mediated diseases.
papers.title_zh: COVID-19時代下的自體免疫疾病：新興機轉、臨床意義、疫苗考量與未來方向
papers.abstract_zh: COVID-19大流行凸顯了SARS-CoV-2感染與自體免疫疾病之間複雜的雙向關係。本綜述探討SARS-CoV-2感染如何影響五種主要自體免疫疾病的發生率、病程進展與預後：全身性紅斑性狼瘡、類風濕性關節炎、多發性硬化症、發炎性腸道疾病，以及格林-巴利症候群。自體免疫疾病患者因內在免疫失調及免疫抑制療法的使用，兩者皆會削弱抗病毒宿主防禦，故COVID-19重症風險增加。反之，COVID-19透過分子模擬與旁觀者活化等機轉，被認為與自體免疫反應的誘發及惡化有關。針對免疫功能低下族群，COVID-19疫苗的安全性與有效性亦引發關注。雖然這些患者對疫苗普遍具耐受性，但某些免疫抑制療法可能減弱體液性與細胞性免疫反應。已有人提出調整免疫抑制方案及優化疫苗接種時機等策略，以提升疫苗效力。疾病特異性的考量對於平衡感染風險與自體免疫活動的充分控制至關重要。整體而言，本綜述強調在COVID-19大流行期間，管理自體免疫疾病患者時，個別化治療策略、密切臨床監測及跨領域照護的重要性。深入理解這些交互作用，對於改善患者預後及為未來涉及免疫相關疾病的大流行做準備，至關重要。

papers.title: Microbiome-metabolite signaling networks in gastrointestinal disease: systems biology, network rewiring, and precision therapeutics
papers.abstract: The gastrointestinal tract operates as a highly integrated, multi-layer signaling ecosystem in which microbial communities, metabolite flux, epithelial receptors, immune circuits, and neuroendocrine pathways form a coordinated regulatory network rather than isolated biological compartments. The Microbiome-Metabolite Signaling Network (MMSN) framework conceptualizes gastrointestinal homeostasis and disease as emergent properties of dynamic cross-layer interactions. This review explores the framework principally on inflammatory bowel disease and irritable bowel syndrome as representative gastrointestinal disorders, drawing on other conditions only for illustrative contrast. Within this architecture, microbiota-derived metabolites including short-chain fatty acids, bile acid derivatives, and tryptophan catabolites serve as biochemical intermediaries that relay ecological signals to host receptor systems such as GPR41/43, FXR, TGR5, the aryl hydrocarbon receptor, and innate immune sensors. These receptor-mediated inputs converge on intracellular signaling hubs, including NF-κB, STAT3, inflammasomes, and neuroimmune mediators, which act as high-centrality nodes governing epithelial integrity, cytokine gradients, metabolic coordination, and visceral sensitivity. Signaling hubs are mechanistic convergence nodes that integrate diverse upstream perturbations into coordinated inflammatory or regulatory outputs. In contrast, network fragility denotes the loss of redundancy, modularity, and buffering capacity, predisposing the system to nonlinear amplification and pathological attractor states. Gastrointestinal disorders are therefore more accurately interpreted as manifestations of network rewiring characterized by hub centralization, metabolite imbalance, and strengthened inter-module coupling rather than simple microbial compositional shifts. This review explains the clinical heterogeneity, fluctuating disease trajectories, and variable therapeutic responsiveness. A network-based translational strategy emphasizes hub stabilization, metabolite recalibration, and restoration of distributed connectivity, shifting precision therapeutics toward topology-informed intervention. Integration of microbiology, immunology, neuroscience, systems biology, and computational medicine establishes a pathway toward predictive, mechanistically grounded gastrointestinal network care.
papers.title_zh: 腸胃道疾病中的微生物群-代謝物訊號網絡：系統生物學、網絡重塑與精準治療
papers.abstract_zh: 腸胃道是一個高度整合的多層次訊號生態系統，其中微生物群落、代謝物流動、上皮受體、免疫迴路與神經內分泌路徑共同形成協調的調控網絡，而非各自獨立的生物區塊。微生物群-代謝物訊號網絡（MMSN）框架將腸胃道恆定與疾病概念化為跨層動態交互作用所產生的湧現特性。本綜述主要以發炎性腸道疾病（IBD）與大腸激躁症（IBS）作為代表性腸胃道疾病來探討此框架，並僅以其他疾病作為對照說明。在此架構中，微生物衍生代謝物，包括短鏈脂肪酸、膽酸衍生物與色胺酸分解代謝物，作為生化中介物將生態訊號傳遞至宿主受體系統，例如 GPR41/43、FXR、TGR5、芳香烴受體及先天免疫感應器。這些受體介導的輸入匯聚於細胞內訊號樞紐，包括 NF-κB、STAT3、發炎小體與神經免疫介質，這些高中心性節點主導上皮完整性、細胞激素梯度、代謝協調與內臟敏感性。訊號樞紐是將多種上游擾動整合為協調發炎或調節輸出的機制性匯聚節點。相對地，網絡脆弱性指的是冗餘性、模組化與緩衝能力的喪失，使系統易於發生非線性放大與病理性吸引子狀態。因此，腸胃道疾病更準確地應被解讀為網絡重塑的表現，其特徵為樞紐中心化、代謝物失衡與模組間耦合增強，而非單純的微生物組成變化。本綜述解釋了臨床異質性、疾病軌跡的波動性以及治療反應的變異性。以網絡為基礎的轉譯策略強調樞紐穩定化、代謝物再校準以及分散式連結性的恢復，將精準治療推向以拓撲學為基礎的介入方式。整合微生物學、免疫學、神經科學、系統生物學與計算醫學，建立了通往可預測、具機制基礎的腸胃道網絡照護之路徑。

papers.title: Piperazine derivatives as anticancer agents: a medicinal chemistry review of structure, mechanism, and clinical translation
papers.journal_full: Medicinal chemistry research : an international journal for rapid communications on design and mechanisms of action of biologically active agents
papers.authors: Porwal T, Kumar R, Tripathi S, Salahuddin
papers.abstract: Piperazine has become essential for designing anticancer drugs because of its basicity, conformational flexibility, and capacity to serve as a solubilizing agent and molecular linker between hybrid pharmacophores. Researchers have found piperazine to function as a medicinal chemistry component that helps develop bioactive scaffolds through its capacity to control solubility, linker design, and target binding properties. The review presents a comprehensive assessment of piperazine-based anticancer drug research published between 2015 and 2025 through its evaluation of clinically relevant medicinal chemistry findings. The literature is organized based on piperazine's three main functional roles, which include its use as a linker and solubilizing/basic motif and direct target-recognition element. The study examines major cancer types through scaffold-based structure-activity relationship (SAR) analysis, which includes breast cancer, liver cancer, colon cancer, cervical cancer, prostate cancer, brain cancer, and leukemia models. The research demonstrated that various derivatives achieved IC₅₀ values in the low-nanomolar to low-micromolar range in MCF-7, HepG2, and HCT-116, HeLa, PC-3, and K562 cell lines. Researchers have demonstrated how protonatable piperazine nitrogens improve aqueous solubility and formulation development, and interactions of enzyme and kinase active sites with acidic residues, which results in better binding strength and selectivity. The review presents major translational obstacles, which include excessive dependence on 2D in vitro studies, insufficient in vivo and ADME/PK information, and limited progress in clinical applications. The research studies the development of clinically usable piperazine-based anticancer drugs through novel methods, which include green chemistry, click chemistry, molecular docking, and QSAR-focused design.
papers.title_zh: 哌嗪衍生物作為抗癌藥物：結構、機轉與臨床轉譯之藥物化學回顧
papers.abstract_zh: 哌嗪因其鹼性、構型彈性，以及作為溶解度增強劑與雜合藥效基團間分子連接子的能力，已成為抗癌藥物設計中不可或缺的元素。研究者發現哌嗪作為藥物化學組件，能透過控制溶解度、連接子設計及標靶結合特性，協助開發生物活性骨架。本文回顧2015至2025年間發表的哌嗪類抗癌藥物研究，評估具臨床相關性的藥物化學發現。文獻依哌嗪三種主要功能角色組織，包括作為連接子、溶解度增強/鹼性基團，以及直接標靶辨識元件。研究以骨架為基礎的構效關係（SAR）分析檢視主要癌症類型，包括乳癌、肝癌、大腸癌、子宮頸癌、攝護腺癌、腦癌及白血病模型。研究顯示各種衍生物在MCF-7、HepG2、HCT-116、HeLa、PC-3及K562細胞株中達到低奈莫爾至低微莫爾範圍的IC50值。研究者已證實可質子化的哌嗪氮原子能改善水溶性及製劑開發，並與酵素及激酶活性部位的酸性殘基交互作用，進而提升結合強度與選擇性。本文提出主要轉譯障礙，包括過度依賴2D體外研究、體內及ADME/PK資訊不足，以及臨床應用進展有限。研究探討透過綠色化學、點擊化學、分子對接及QSAR導向設計等新方法，發展臨床可用哌嗪類抗癌藥物之進展。

papers.title: A scoping review on emerging biomarkers in inflammatory bowel disease: Towards precision medicine in diagnosis and therapeutic management
papers.authors: da Silva M, Souza Menezes J, Esteves Francisco J, Michele da Silva F, Rocha P, de Oliveira Ruiz P
papers.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Inflammatory Bowel Diseases (IBD) are chronic conditions presenting significant diagnostic and management challenges. Current invasive methods and traditional biomarkers often lack sufficient accuracy and fail to address the disease's heterogeneity and unpredictable therapeutic responses. This necessitates more precise, personalized clinical tools.
METHODS: This scoping review synthesized recent findings on emerging biomarkers for IBD. We focused on technological advances in omics platforms (genomics, transcriptomics, proteomics, metabolomics, microbiomics), artificial intelligence, biosensors, and imaging techniques. Analysis identified biomarker potential for early diagnosis, disease activity monitoring, progression prognosis, and therapeutic response prediction. The review adhered to PRISMA-ScR guidelines and was registered with the Open Science Framework (OSF). The search encompassed five major databases: PubMed/MEDLINE, Scopus, Web of Science, Embase, and Google Scholar.
RESULTS: Studies demonstrate vast potential in non-invasive biomarkers for refined early diagnosis, optimized disease monitoring, and treatment response prediction. Key findings include metabolomic and gut microbiota profiles, genetic and epigenetic markers, and AI integration of complex data. These approaches promise to overcome conventional indicator limitations. From 784 initial records, 27 articles were included, published between 2021 and 2025.
CONCLUSION: Emerging biomarkers are fundamental for the transition to precision medicine in IBD. Their implementation aims to enhance pathogenesis understanding, personalize therapies, and improve patient quality of life, establishing pathways for more effective, individualized management approaches.

papers.title_zh: 發炎性腸道疾病新興生物標記範疇性回顧：邁向精準醫學之診斷與治療管理
papers.abstract_zh:
背景：發炎性腸道疾病（IBD）為慢性疾病，在診斷與治療管理上面臨重大挑戰。目前的侵入性檢查方法與傳統生物標記常缺乏足夠準確度，且無法因應疾病異質性與難以預測的治療反應，因此需要更精準、個人化的臨床工具。

方法：本範疇性回顧統整近期關於IBD新興生物標記之研究發現。聚焦於體學平台（基因體學、轉錄體學、蛋白體學、代謝體學、微生物體學）、人工智慧、生物感測器與影像技術等技術進展。分析辨識出生物標記在早期診斷、疾病活動度監測、病程預後及治療反應預測上的潛力。本回顧遵循PRISMA-ScR指引，並於Open Science Framework（OSF）註冊。檢索涵蓋五大資料庫：PubMed/MEDLINE、Scopus、Web of Science、Embase及Google Scholar。

結果：研究顯示非侵入性生物標記在精進早期診斷、優化疾病監測及治療反應預測上具有龐大潛力。關鍵發現包括代謝體與腸道微生物群特徵、基因與表觀遺傳標記，以及人工智慧整合複雜資料。這些方法有望克服傳統指標之限制。從784篇初始文獻中，納入27篇文章，發表於2021至2025年間。

結論：新興生物標記是IBD邁向精準醫學轉型的根本要素。其應用旨在增進對致病機轉的理解、個人化治療，並改善病人生活品質，為更有效、個人化的管理方式建立途徑。
